criteria.description: Exactly one h1, one description, two marketing CTA links, one full-cover media trigger with one image/scrim/play icon, and one ren-dialog with one loader and one iframe; no form/nav/logo/background-video/third CTA
Full-svh vertical shell with a flexible upper media region and content-sized lower band; no root overflow at 320/390/767/768/1280
Lower band stacks h1 before copy/actions on mobile and becomes two top-aligned columns at medium widths; CTA cluster wraps
Trigger opens one native Ren10 modal; loader precedes deterministic playable iframe; close button, Escape, and backdrop dismiss; focus restores and media unloads
Without JavaScript, image/copy/two CTA destinations remain usable and a real owned video-alternative link is visible
Accessible names, visible focus, 44px targets, reduced motion, light/dark, native dialog semantics, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA pass
Fresh desktop, tablet, seam, mobile, dark, reduced-motion, open-lightbox, and JavaScript-disabled captures are inspected against the complete reference brief
